arguments.title: Airport Operations and Turnaround Control Center
arguments.spec:
# Airport Operations and Turnaround Control Center — foundation requirements

- Flight, aircraft, airline, gate, stand, belt, crew, equipment, turnaround task, passenger connection, delay code, NOTAM-like notice, and disruption models.
- Gate and stand assignment engine with aircraft size, domestic/international status, tow requirements, connection banks, maintenance holds, and gate conflicts.
- Turnaround milestone tracker for blocks-on, chocks, bridge, deplaning, cleaning, catering, fueling, boarding, baggage, pushback, and doors closed.
- Baggage belt planner with arrival waves, belt capacity, transfer bags, oversize handling, and failed equipment.
- Ground-crew rostering and equipment allocation for pushback tugs, belt loaders, fuel trucks, cleaners, and deicing trucks.
- Disruption manager for late inbound aircraft, weather ground stop, gate closure, equipment failure, and crew shortage.
- Passenger impact estimator for missed connections, gate changes, bus transfers, and minimum connection times.
- Seed day-of-operations scenario with snow delay, gate outage, missed inbound, belt failure, and competing recovery strategies.

Deterministic tests only (node:test, zero dependencies); every finding carries evidence; no network in acceptance.
arguments.plan:
# Implementation plan

Bottom-up dependency order: scaffold, then the core domain model, then one deterministic evaluate module per foundation concern (model → engine → edge cases), closing with a flagship integration test + README. Every card ships its own node:test coverage; acceptance is `npm test` everywhere.
arguments.summary: Build the Airport Operations and Turnaround Control Center foundation bottom-up: scaffold, typed domain model, deterministic evaluate modules per foundation concern, then a flagship integration test with an explainable evidence chain.

tasks.title: Project scaffold: zero-dependency node test wiring
tasks.prompt: Create the npm scaffold: package.json (private, type module, test script = node --test, NO dependencies) plus a README stub naming the product. npm test must exit 0 before any feature card lands. Do not add TypeScript or external test frameworks — the foundation uses plain ESM JavaScript with JSDoc types and node:test.

tasks.title: Core domain model and stable identifiers
tasks.prompt: Create src/domain.mjs: JSDoc-typed factories and validators for the core entities (flight, aircraft, airline, gate, stand, belt, crew, equipment, turnaround). Every entity gets a stable string id, a createdAt ISO timestamp taken from an injected clock function, and an appendAudit(entry) helper that never mutates prior entries. Add test/domain.test.mjs (node:test) covering id stability, audit append-only behavior, and validator rejection of malformed input.

Add node:test coverage for the accepted path and at least one blocking path.
